info.title: WABrain API
info.description: Self-hosted, read-only WhatsApp task and memory layer. See docs/API.md.

post.summary: Exchange a pairing code for a device token

get.summary: Full snapshot or delta since a cursor
This device's unacknowledged Review, reminder and summary notifications (fallback for missed pushes)

post.summary: Mark notifications as handled on this device

patch.summary: Update a chat rule (mode=off purges data)

get.summary: A fact's stored source messages, each with its own chatId (purged messages are omitted)

delete.summary: Delete a person and their chats' data

get.summary: Settings, with the read-only auto-create status

post.summary: Ask your chats: a read-only answer from stored messages, with validated citations

429.description: `rate_limited`: per-device throttling. `budget_exceeded`: the daily text-model budget is used up. Both send Retry-After (seconds); for the budget it points to local midnight

503.description: The text model did not answer

post.summary: Create a device pairing QR payload

get.summary: Model provider settings per role (API keys are never returned)

put.summary: Save model provider settings; API keys are write-only and stored encrypted

post.summary: Make one small test call per configured role

get.summary: OpenWA reachability and the WhatsApp session state (read-only key)

post.summary: Check the read key with GET requests only; warns when the key could send
